Thank you for reviewing StarTier.

1. SCREEN RECORDING
A screen recording made on an iPhone is attached. It starts at app launch and shows sign-up, login, the feed, playing a video and song, a Star uploading, report and block, opening a purchase, and the Delete my account screen.

2. WHAT THE APP IS FOR
StarTier is a place for new, independent artists ("Stars") to share and sell their music, videos and art, and for fans ("Supporters") to discover them. Big platforms pay small artists very little; on StarTier artists keep 85% of their sales. Audience: people 13 and older who like new music.

3. HOW TO USE IT / TEST ACCOUNTS
There are two account types. Both test accounts have the paid plan turned on, so all content plays in full.
- Star (artist): the account in the Sign-In fields above. Tap the account circle (top right), then Your studio, to upload and see earnings.
- Fan (Supporter): mrjordan011+startierfan@gmail.com / [fan password]. Swipe the home feed, play StarTier Radio, open an artist page, follow, comment and message.
Sign in with Apple and Sign in with Google also work.
Report and block: open an artist page or post, tap the three dots (More options), then Report or Block.
Delete account: tap the account circle (top right), then Delete my account at the bottom.

4. OUTSIDE SERVICES THE APP USES
- Supabase: accounts and database
- Bunny.net Stream: video and audio hosting
- Stripe: payments, on a secure web checkout page
- Sign in with Apple and Google sign-in
- An AI model that powers the StarTier Help chat (through n8n on our own server)
- Hetzner: our web server

5. REGIONS
The app is offered in the United States only and works the same everywhere in the U.S. Digital purchases (All-Access, Galaxies, buying a song or video) open our website's Stripe checkout through an external link, as allowed on the United States storefront. You do not need to complete a purchase to review the app.

6. CONTENT RIGHTS
Artists upload only their own work and agree to our Terms. We have a Copyright Policy with a DMCA agent (King Jordan Media LLC), and anyone can report stolen work in the app.
